blurb: Brick Streets Brewery is located in a 2,000-square-foot red brick building in downtown Corsicana. They offer a rotating tap list featuring a wide selection of beer styles including IPAs, stouts, lagers, and experimental brews. The brewery has a cozy taproom and a spacious outdoor beer garden for guests to enjoy their drinks.
